# Miuix component sources

Upstream: https://github.com/compose-miuix-ui/miuix
Commit: `17138ef67967e6d57d3cee03893964d85b25afbd`

Includes unmodified commonMain/androidMain sources for core, shader, squircle, ui, preference and icons. Local Gradle files build only the Android target; the squircle SDF generation task is retained from upstream. Apache-2.0; see LICENSE.
